entries.54381decb964419b: Corporations and Organizations Hosting Banquets and Meetings
entries.6dc8ade17ff42a0d: A company that operates banquet halls, wedding venues and restaurants, centered on its main building in Marunouchi, and also sells Western-style confectionery and other items.
entries.78503e513ef82b8f: This is a single-segment business that operates banquet halls, wedding venues and restaurants, and sells Western-style confectionery and other products. Centered on the Main Building (Honkan) in Marunouchi, it provides banquet, wedding and dining services at each sales office, including contracted management. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,259 million, broken down by division into banquets at ¥11,561 million, dining at ¥3,548 million, and shops and other at ¥1,150 million.
